results.name: inspektorGadgetExtension
results.reason: The exact stable 2025-03-01 Learn and pinned REST schemas were read. Both identify 2025-03-01 as the latest GA; stable REST tree versions end at 2025-03-01. The body schema resolves through common ProxyResource: response-only id/name/type are readOnly, while the source supplies the properties. All three property types and exact documented values match; the exact Inspektor Gadget install guidance confirms extensionType, lowercase preview releaseTrain, and default minor auto-upgrade.
results.migration: Current API 2025-03-01 is already the latest GA. The extension product is preview, but the declared API version is stable; no API-version migration is needed. The 2025-03 change log adds other properties and does not change any of the three used properties.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original Bicep JSON Pointer /name maps to the PUT path parameter {extensionName}; the source name inspektor-gadget is the exact name used by the official Learn install command. The REST request example supplies resource identity in the path, not a writable body name.

usage.label: scope
usage.analysis: Bicep scope selects the existing Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters parent and forms the cluster segment of the REST path ({clusterRp}/{clusterResourceName}/{clusterName}/providers/Microsoft.KubernetesConfiguration/extensions/{extensionName}). This is a Bicep language deployment-scope property, not REST JSON properties.scope (which separately controls cluster/namespace installation).

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: Original /properties is the REST ExtensionProperties object. It contains only extensionType, releaseTrain, and autoUpgradeMinorVersion in this declaration; each is separately checked below. No required writable properties are omitted; common ProxyResource id/name/type are response-only.

usage.label: extensionType
usage.analysis: REST properties.extensionType is string and must identify a type registered with Microsoft.KubernetesConfiguration. The exact source literal microsoft.inspektorgadget is the extension type used in Microsoft Learn’s Inspektor Gadget AKS install command.

usage.label: releaseTrain
usage.analysis: REST properties.releaseTrain is string (no enum constraint); when auto-upgrade is enabled it identifies the train. Microsoft Learn’s exact Inspektor Gadget install command specifies lowercase --release-train preview, matching the source literal.

usage.label: autoUpgradeMinorVersion
usage.analysis: REST properties.autoUpgradeMinorVersion is boolean. Literal true matches the schema and the Learn guide states minor auto-upgrade is enabled by default for this extension.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: Resource declaration header uses Microsoft.KubernetesConfiguration/extensions@2025-03-01. Learn identifies this as Latest; at the pinned REST commit the only stable versions are 2024-11-01 and 2025-03-01, so it is already latest GA.

current.analysis: Fetched exact Learn resource page and pinned stable OpenAPI. Extension resolves through common ProxyResource; id/name/type are read-only response properties, and request body properties are the ExtensionProperties schema. extensionType/releaseTrain are strings, autoUpgradeMinorVersion boolean. The official Inspektor Gadget install article confirms the exact extension type and preview train; the pinned example confirms the request body shape and parent cluster route.

ga.analysis: Learn version selector labels 2025-03-01 as Latest and provides no later stable API. The complete pinned resource-manager tree has stable extension schemas only for 2024-11-01 and 2025-03-01 (older previews are not GA); the exact 2025-03-01 schema is therefore both current and latest GA. No candidate API change is required.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log for 2025-03-01 lists additions (including additionalDetails, autoUpgradeMode, extensionState, managementDetails) but none modify extensionType, releaseTrain, or autoUpgradeMinorVersion. Learn install steps use microsoft.inspektorgadget, lowercase release-train preview, and default enabled minor auto-upgrade, matching all source values.
